stem.text: A binary star consists of two stars rotating around a common centre. Light from one of the stars is observed on the Earth.

stem.alt: Dashed circular orbit with two grey dots on it, labelled binary star, with arrowheads on the orbit; an eye symbol labelled observer on Earth.

stem.text: The observed frequency of the light varies between a minimum frequency $f_\text{min}$ and a maximum frequency $f_\text{max}$, as shown.

stem.alt: Graph of observed frequency against time, with a wave-shaped curve between dashed lines marked f_max and f_min, origin 0.

stem.text: The rate of rotation of the binary star increases.
What is the change to $f_\text{max}$ and the change to $f_\text{min}$?
